metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer safety gear for your team. Durable decoration on vests, hats & more. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives your safety gear crisp, full-color logos that hold up to repeated washing and daily wear. Unlike screen printing, heat transfers allow detailed artwork and gradients on high-vis vests, hard hats, and work gloves without adding bulk. Safety managers often choose this method for customizing reflective gear because the decal bonds smoothly to polyester and mesh fabrics. It is a practical option for small to medium runs where setup cost matters.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer safety gear including high-vis vests and hard hats with full-color logos
